script.title: How UPI Payments Actually Work Behind the Scenes
script.description: Learn how UPI transfers money between bank accounts in seconds using NPCI infrastructure. Understand the technical role of IMPS, RBI regulation, and how to stay safe during digital transfers.

scenes.narration: UPI handles seven thousand payments every second; one central system routes them.
Unified Payments Interface is an instant payment protocol created by NPCI in twenty sixteen.
Say you transfer one hundred rupees using a unique UPI ID on your phone.
It runs as an open source application programming interface on top of IMPS.
NPCI acts as a central switch, instantly matching sender and receiver bank servers.
UPI processes an average of nearly seven thousand five hundred transactions every second.
It is used on mobile devices to instantly transfer funds between two bank accounts.
The system is regulated by RBI. This is education, not financial advice.
Seven thousand transactions happen every second. How many UPI payments do you make daily?
